channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Moro aponta “grande absurdo ilegal” no caso de Bolsonaro
item.description: Former judge Sergio Moro (PL-PR), pre-candidate for governor of Parana, called the STF minister Alexandre de Moraes' decision granting Jair Bolsonaro 48 hours to explain the use of his image and voice in a video a "great illegal absurdity." Moro criticized the measure as arbitrary and offensive to due process.

item.title: TSE exige plano de big techs para combater desinformação com IA
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques signed an ordinance requiring digital platforms with over 5 million users to submit a 'compliance plan' to counter disinformation in the 2026 elections. The plan must detail how big techs will identify and label AI-generated content, ensuring electoral neutrality and preventing systems like ChatGPT from favoring candidates or parties. The measure aims to prevent AI from influencing votes in a partisan manner.

item.title: Lula: ‘Com Alckmin de vice, nunca vamos dormir e ter um golpe pela manhã’
item.description: Lula praised Vice President Geraldo Alckmin as a guarantee of loyalty and honesty, stating that his presence eliminates the possibility of a coup. He also criticized Bolsonaro, calling him a 'homicide' due to over 700,000 pandemic deaths, and reiterated the support of a left and center-left coalition for his reelection bid.

item.title: Lula chama Bolsonaro de 'homicida' em convenção do PSB que oficializou Alckmin como vice
item.description: Lula called Bolsonaro a 'homicida' during the pandemic, stating he was responsible for more than half of Brazil's COVID-19 deaths due to his handling of the health crisis. The remarks were made at the PSB national convention, which formalized the party's support for Lula's re-election and Geraldo Alckmin as his running mate. Alckmin praised Lula's loyalty and honesty and condemned extremists who undermine democracy and invoke God's name in vain.

item.title: Lula chama Bolsonaro de “homicida” e exalta Alckmin: “Com ele não vai ter golpe”
item.description: President Lula called former President Jair Bolsonaro a 'homicide' due to deaths during the COVID-19 pandemic and praised Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, stating that with him there will be no coup. The remarks were made at the PSB national convention.

item.title: TRE-SP multa Lula por propaganda eleitoral antecipada; cabe recurso
item.description: The São Paulo Regional Electoral Court (TRE-SP) fined President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva R$15,000 for premature electoral campaigning, following a May 19 event where he allegedly solicited votes for Simone Tebet and Marina Silva. The judge ruled the statement contained an unequivocal request for electoral support, despite Lula’s defense claiming it was institutional in nature. An appeal is permitted.

item.title: PSB oficializa candidatura de Alckmin à Vice-Presidência da República
item.description: The Brazilian Socialist Party (PSB) officially endorsed Geraldo Alckmin as the vice-presidential candidate on Lula's ticket, confirming PT's support for the president's reelection. Alckmin, a physician and former governor of São Paulo, joined the PSB in 2022 and was elected vice president on the same ticket in 2022. The PT's national convention is expected to formally confirm Lula's candidacy on Sunday, August 2.

item.title: Crise com Milei: Após reunião com Vieira e Lula, embaixador do Brasil na Argentina voltará ao País
item.description: Brazil's ambassador to Argentina, Julio Bitelli, will return to Brazil after meeting with Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira and President Lula, following orders to 'close the case' on Argentine President Javier Milei's insults, in which he called Lula a 'prisoner' and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes 'bald trash'. Despite the provocations, expressions of solidarity toward Brazil emerged in Argentina, including from the Argentine Municipalities Federation, which labeled Milei's remarks an 'unacceptable lack of respect' and warned of risks to bilateral trade relations.

item.title: Haddad aposta em propostas para reduzir vantagem de Tarcísio
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT candidate for governor of São Paulo, stated that the race is 'stable' with a roughly 10-point deficit to Tarcísio de Freitas, and aims to close the gap through policy proposals. He emphasized the launch of the Quilombo in Parliament Manifesto, focused on combating racial quota frauds, political violence based on race and gender, and ensuring proportional allocation of electoral resources to Black candidates. Polls from Paraná Pesquisa and Quaest show Tarcísio leading with 48.5%, enough to win in the first round, while Haddad trails at 35.1%.

item.title: Pesquisa: a disputa Lula x Flávio nos estados que somam mais de 50% do eleitorado do Brasil
item.description: In São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Paraná, Flávio Bolsonaro leads Lula in the first round, while in Bahia and Minas Gerais the president is ahead, with a numerical edge in Minas and clear lead in Bahia. Together, these five states account for 52.45% of the national electorate, making them decisive for the 2026 election. The Quaest surveys, conducted between July 22 and 27, show Lula performing better in second-round scenarios against Bolsonaro in Minas Gerais and Bahia, while Bolsonaro maintains an advantage in the three largest colleges of the Southeast and South.

item.title: Embaixador brasileiro na Argentina se reúne com Lula e ficará no Brasil por tempo indeterminado
item.description: Brazil's ambassador to Argentina, Júlio Bitelli, was summoned to Brasília for consultations after Argentine President Javier Milei made offensive remarks against Lula and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The Brazilian government has decided to keep Bitelli in Brazil indefinitely while assessing the bilateral relationship, awaiting signs of reconciliation from Argentina. The embassy in Buenos Aires is currently being led by a chargé d'affaires.

item.title: Luciana Santos chora em homenagem ao marido na convenção do PSB
item.description: Minister of Science and Technology Luciana Santos (PC do B) cried during the PSB National Convention in Brasília while honoring her late husband, state deputy Waldemar Borges (PSB-PE), who died on July 10 at age 67. The emotional tribute highlighted his political legacy in Pernambuco.

item.title: Governo Lula rebate EUA após prorrogação de estado de emergência
item.description: The Lula government denounced as 'baseless' and 'unfounded' the U.S. extension of a national emergency against Brazil, arguing that accusations of Brazil posing an unusual threat to U.S. security lack factual basis and ignore Brazil’s sovereignty and long-standing diplomatic friendship.

item.title: Para alguns dos maiores grupos políticos, serve qualquer presidente da República
item.description: Brazil’s major parties, including MDB and PSD, have adopted a neutral stance in the 2026 presidential elections, prioritizing congressional seat gains over endorsing a specific candidate. This strategy, driven by high polarization and control over parliamentary amendments, allows regional directories to support any candidate — from Lula to Caiado or Flávio — based on local convenience. The Supreme Court, led by Minister Flávio Dino, is pushing back by demanding a 'responsibility plan' for mandatory amendments and threatening to declare them unconstitutional, risking civil disobedience from entrenched party bosses linked to scandals like Master.

item.title: Alckmin é confirmado como vice e vai reeditar chapa vitoriosa de Lula
item.description: Geraldo Alckmin has been officially confirmed as the vice-presidential candidate on Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's ticket for the 2026 elections, recreating the winning alliance from 2022. The confirmation was made at a PSB event in Brasília on July 29, 2026, following Lula’s earlier announcement in a ministerial meeting on March 31. The ticket aims to defeat Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), and if elected, Lula would become Brazil’s oldest president and the first to serve a fourth term.

item.title: Geraldo Alckmin venceu a desconfiança de petistas e se consolidou como 'companheiro' de Lula, de quem foi rival em 2006
item.description: Geraldo Alckmin, former rival of Lula in 2006 and former PSDB leader, has been confirmed as the vice-presidential candidate on Lula’s re-election ticket for 2026. The PSB officially nominated him at a national convention, following Lula’s March announcement that the 'Lula with chuchu' alliance would be renewed, dispelling PT rumors of a replacement. Alckmin, noted for his understated style and nickname 'chuchu popsicle', earned petista trust through his productive sector engagement, particularly in countering U.S. tariffs, becoming Lula’s trusted 'companion' in the third term.

item.title: Geraldo Alckmin é oficializado pelo PSB como candidato à vice-presidência na chapa de Lula à reeleição
item.description: The Brazilian Socialist Party (PSB) officially nominated Geraldo Alckmin as the vice-presidential candidate on Lula's re-election ticket for 2026, during a national convention in Brasília. The coalition includes the PT, PCdoB, PV, PDT, PSol, and Rede, replicating the winning alliance from 2022. Alckmin criticized the previous government, defending democracy as the guardian of liberty and stating that those who do not believe in the electoral process should not run for office.

item.title: Compra de votos? Lula usa Super El Niño para distribuir cestas básicas
item.description: The Lula government announced it will use the Super El Niño climate phenomenon to expand the distribution of basic food baskets ahead of the October elections. The measure was disclosed by Chief of Staff Miriam Belchior in a public meeting, sparking criticism that the government is attempting to buy votes by linking social aid to a climatic event.

item.title: Plataformas digitais devem enviar planos de conformidade ao TSE até 16 de agosto
item.description: The TSE has required digital platforms to submit compliance plans by August 16 for the 2026 electoral period, including commitments to monitor, remove content, combat gender-based political violence, and report coordinated inauthentic behavior. The measure aims to safeguard electoral integrity and already applies to cases such as the alleged network of fake accounts that reportedly boosted disinformation against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Ancelotti foca no meio-campo no processo de reconstrução da Seleção Brasileira
item.description: Brazil national team coach Carlo Ancelotti stated that finding high-level midfielders is a priority in rebuilding the team after the 2026 World Cup failure. He emphasized the need to strengthen the midfield to restore the team's competitiveness.

item.title: Tarcísio adia “free flow” na Imigrantes e anuncia reposicionamento
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas postponed the launch of the free-flow electronic toll system (Siga Fácil) on the Imigrantes Highway following protests from residents of São Bernardo do Campo. The northbound toll gantry was relocated from km 32 to km 38, while the southbound gantry remains at km 29 and the Anchieta Highway equipment stays at km 33. The current toll of R$ 40,60 in the coastal direction will remain until the new system is operational, at which point the fee will be split into R$ 20,30 for each direction of the mountain range.

item.title: Após eliminação nas oitavas, Ancelotti revisita lista de convocados: "Correta"
item.description: Coach Carlo Ancelotti defended Brazil's 2026 World Cup squad selection, stating that despite injuries and limited preparation time, the final list was correct. He noted that surprise inclusions like Weverton, Neymar, Endrick, and Rayan had few appearances under him before the final roster. Ancelotti also confirmed he kept Neymar in the squad despite a recent injury, while omitting João Pedro, who had been named Chelsea's best player of the season.

item.title: Em meio a novo ataque às urnas, TSE diz quais empresas fabricam os aparelhos
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) disclosed that Brazil's electronic voting machines are manufactured exclusively by four Brazilian companies: Positivo Tecnologia, Diebold, Unisys Brasil, and Procomp Indústria Eletrônica, refuting claims that they are made by Venezuelan firm Smartmatic. The TSE emphasizes that the machines undergo rigorous security testing at least one year before elections and are not commercially available, being produced under exclusive bidding by the Electoral Justice. Statements by Flávio Bolsonaro, Eduardo Bolsonaro, and Jair Bolsonaro alleging fraud in the voting system are false and part of a growing conspiracy narrative ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Flávio deu aval à negativa ao STF sobre vídeo de Bolsonaro com IA
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, acting as legal counsel for former President Jair Bolsonaro, told the STF that the AI-generated video shown at the PL convention — in which Bolsonaro appears to endorse his son’s candidacy — was not authorized by the former president due to judicial restrictions preventing communication between them. The defense argues that the visitation ban and contact prohibition make prior consent impossible, and that the video’s dissemination constitutes a potential violation of house arrest conditions.

item.title: Governo Lula repudia prorrogação de emergência dos EUA contra o Brasil
item.description: The Lula government rejected the extension of the U.S. national emergency against Brazil, calling the accusations 'baseless and false'. The extension keeps the emergency in effect after July 30, 2026, but does not introduce new tariffs. The Planalto defended Brazilian sovereignty and the independence of the Judiciary, particularly the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: O cafezinho de Lula com Moraes
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva invited Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to have coffee during a ceremony at the Planalto Palace focused on signing laws to protect women. The informal invitation was picked up by microphones and sparked media attention. The gesture reflects an attempt at dialogue between the Executive and Judiciary amid institutional tensions.

item.title: Justiça nega indenização de Van Hattem ao PT por falas sobre fraude no INSS
item.description: The 15th Civil Court of Brasília dismissed the PT's moral damages claim against federal deputy Marcel Van Hattem (Novo-RS), ruling that his statements during the INSS CPI, although lacking evidence and deemed unacceptable by the judge, are protected by parliamentary immunity. The PT alleged Van Hattem falsely accused the Lula government of leading a fraud scheme against retirees and disabled persons in the INSS. The judge also ordered the PT to pay court costs and attorney fees amounting to 10% of the case value.

item.title: TSE atende PL e manda Meta preservar dados de perfis contra Flávio
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, ordered Meta to preserve data from a network of profiles suspected of coordinated action against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president in 2026. The PL’s complaint alleges that over 50 phantom pages, funded by unidentified sources possibly including foreign currency, published around 4,600 paid ads reaching nearly 250 million views, forming a sophisticated digital manipulation scheme. The ruling aims to trace financiers, administrators, and technical operators of the network, which the party claims undermines electoral fairness.

item.title: É descabido caracterizar Brasil como ameaça aos Estados Unidos, diz governo Lula
item.description: The Lula government condemned the U.S. decision to extend for another year the national emergency declaration against Brazil, calling it unfounded to label Brazil as a threat to the United States. The Planalto Palace statement emphasized historical diplomatic ties and friendship between the two peoples, rejecting the claims as baseless and untrue. Brazil reaffirmed its sovereignty and the independence of its branches of government, noting the Judiciary’s adherence to constitutional principles.

item.title: Durigan indica Lula 4 mais austero e tenta acalmar o mercado
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan sought to calm financial markets by signaling a commitment to a stricter fiscal framework in a potential fourth Lula term, emphasizing that the economic team is empowered to set policy direction, though without specifying concrete measures. This contrasts with the expansionist outlook of Lula's campaign program coordinator, Sergio Gabrielli, which has raised market concerns, even as polls show Lula as a strong favorite for re-election in 2026.

item.title: O convite de Lula para Alexandre de Moraes, após evento no Planalto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva invited Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes for a coffee following a law-signing ceremony at the Planalto Palace. Moraes, who oversees the penal execution of former President Jair Bolsonaro, accepted the invitation, indicating the conversation would take place on-site. The meeting occurs amid sensitive judicial rulings involving Bolsonaro and his family, including the suspension of visits by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to his father and a ban on political manifestations by the former president.

item.title: Autoexilado nos EUA, Eduardo Bolsonaro desiste de disputar eleições
item.description: Former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL) announced he is withdrawing as a substitute candidate for André do Prado in the São Paulo Senate race for the 2026 elections. The decision followed consultations with lawyers and was driven by what he described as 'grave legal insecurity' and 'political persecution' against him and his family. Eduardo stated the move aims to preserve a broader political project for Brazil's future.

item.title: "Muito, muito importante", diz Ancelotti sobre Endrick na Seleção
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti praised Endrick as one of the pillars of the Brazilian national team for the cycle leading to the 2030 World Cup, highlighting his talent and future importance. The coach emphasized that limited playing time has been the main obstacle to the young forward's development, despite his already proven potential.

item.title: Governo Lula 'repudia' decisão dos EUA de prorrogar emergência contra o Brasil
item.description: The Lula government denounced the U.S. decision to extend by one year the national emergency declaration against Brazil under IEEPA, calling the accusations baseless and reaffirming Brazilian sovereignty and judicial independence. Although no new sanctions or tariffs are imposed, the move is seen as a symbolic U.S. offensive rooted in unsubstantiated claims of human rights abuses and political persecution, which Brazil has already refuted in bilateral talks.

item.title: De chápeu sertanejo, Flávio visita rancho de Amado Batista em Goiás
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president in 2026, visited the ranch of sertanejo singer Amado Batista in Goiás, strengthening ties with the Bolsonaro family and political allies such as Wilder Morais and Gustavo Gayer. During the meeting, the singer praised Jair Bolsonaro's administration as the best in recent Brazilian history and expressed support for Flávio's political project, who gifted Batista a yellow T-shirt featuring the former president's face.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral condena Lula por propaganda antecipada por pedido de votos para Simone Tebet e Marina Silva
item.description: Judge Ronnie Herbert Barros Soares of the TRE-SP convicted Lula to pay a R$ 15 thousand fine for premature electoral campaigning during the Enic event on May 19, when he explicitly asked for votes for Simone Tebet and Marina Silva. The ruling determined that the statement constituted an explicit request for electoral support before the legally permitted period, violating Law 9.504/97 and TSE Resolution 23.610/19. Tebet and Silva were acquitted due to lack of evidence of prior knowledge or involvement in the act.

item.title: Dívida do governo Lula cresce R$ 7,9 bilhões ao dia em junho
item.description: The federal government's debt grew by R$ 7.9 billion per day in June, totaling R$ 235.7 billion for the month and pushing the gross debt of the Union to R$ 9.268 trillion by the end of the first half of 2026. The increase was driven by net issuances of R$ 142.25 billion and accumulated interest of R$ 93.48 billion, reflecting a greater reliance on Selic-linked securities and rising foreign investor interest, which added R$ 6.9 billion in holdings. The National Treasury Secretariat warns the trend pressures the public budget and limits investment funds, while the government plans to adjust debt composition starting in September.

item.title: Tarifaço une católicos e evangélicos que veem ingerência eleitoral de Trump
item.description: Most Catholics and evangelicals in Brazil view the new U.S. tariff on Brazilian products as direct interference in national sovereignty, not merely economic protectionism, but as an attempt to influence the October elections. They regard the measure as an electoral action by Trump that violates the country’s autonomy.

item.title: Lula fala em reformas após criticar CNJ e CNMP, instituídos por ele
item.description: President Lula criticized the CNJ and CNMP, institutions he created, for failing to fulfill their oversight role and called for new institutional reforms across all branches of government. He linked the critique to gender-based violence, highlighting the sanctioning of the 'Pix Pensão' and Ligue 180 law as practical advances in women's protection. Lula stated that behavioral change requires coordinated action from Congress, Judiciary, Executive, and police to transform society.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro desiste de concorrer como suplente de candidato ao Senado em SP
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro announced he will not run as first alternate on the PL's Senate ticket in São Paulo for 2026, citing his eight-year ineligibility following a unanimous STF conviction for coercion and legal insecurity. He obtained a U.S. green card in April 2025 and stated his decision aims to protect a larger political project and avoid jeopardizing André do Prado's strategic Senate candidacy. Following his withdrawal, Fernando Fiori de Godoy becomes first alternate and Rute Costa second alternate.

item.title: Governo Lula repudia decisão dos EUA em prorrogar sanções e diz ser 'descabido' caracterizar Brasil como ameaça
item.description: The Lula government condemned the U.S. decision to extend sanctions against Brazil under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, calling it 'unfounded' and 'absurd' to characterize Brazil as a threat. The Planalto statement emphasized Brazil’s sovereignty, the independence of its judiciary, and rejected U.S. claims regarding freedom of expression and political persecution, citing strong historical ties between the two nations.

item.title: Pensão alimentícia será recebida de forma automática, via pix
item.description: President Lula signed two laws to protect women: the 'Pix Pension', which ensures automatic alimony payments via Pix when payroll deduction is not possible, and the widespread dissemination of Ligue 180, a hotline for reporting violence against women. The measures aim to secure basic rights and expand access to protection, particularly for mothers and victims of domestic violence.

item.title: TRE-SP multa Lula em R$ 15.000 por propaganda eleitoral antecipada
item.description: The TRE-SP fined President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva R$15,000 for premature election campaigning after he mentioned Simone Tebet and Marina Silva during a government event on May 19, 2026, suggesting the public could 'one day' vote for them. Judge Ronnie Herbert Barros Soares ruled the statement constituted an explicit and unequivocal request for votes outside the legal campaign period, ordering the removal of the YouTube video. Lula’s defense may appeal to the TRE-SP and then the TSE.

item.title: TSE manda big techs explicarem moderação de conteúdo eleitoral, mas permite sigilo sobre dados de IA
item.description: The TSE has ordered big tech companies to explain how they will ensure compliance with electoral propaganda laws, marking an unprecedented requirement for proof of adherence to anti-disinformation rules. While platforms have been obligated since 2024 to block false or decontextualized information, they must now detail their moderation methods. However, the tribunal allowed secrecy over the AI data used in these processes.

item.title: André do Prado confirma Eduardo Bolsonaro fora da chapa ao Senado por SP
item.description: André do Prado announced that Eduardo Bolsonaro is out of the Senate ticket for São Paulo due to his ineligibility declared by the STF after being convicted of obstructing justice. Eduardo stepped down voluntarily, and André said the decision was respected, emphasizing commitment to a larger project involving Tarcísio de Freitas and Flávio Bolsonaro. The ticket now consists of André as the candidate, Fernando Fiori de Godoy as first alternate, and Rute Costa as second alternate.

item.title: Inelegível, Eduardo Bolsonaro desiste de disputar Senado como suplente de André do Prado
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro withdrew from running as a Senate substitute on André do Prado's (PL) ticket due to his ineligibility following a recent STF conviction, avoiding the risk of the entire PL ticket being rejected under the Clean Record Law. Prado confirmed that the substitute positions will go to Fernando Godoy and Rute Costa, both PL members, and praised Eduardo's decision as responsible and aligned with a broader project for São Paulo and Brazil. The withdrawal comes before the official campaign period begins on August 16, amid polls showing opposition candidates like Marina Silva and Simone Tebet with an advantage.

item.title: Nunes Marques manda Meta preservar dados de perfis suspeitos de atacar Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques ordered Meta to preserve data from profiles suspected of boosting negative content against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, following reports of over R$1.1 million in ad spending by pages with few followers. The measure aims to prevent data deletion before the investigation concludes into a potential network of fake accounts, with indications of up to 20,000 similar accounts involved.

item.title: Ancelotti fala ao Metrópoles sobre eliminação na Copa, Neymar e 2030
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti, head coach of the Brazilian national team, spoke to Metrópoles about Brazil's elimination in the 2026 World Cup, expressing disappointment over the loss due to the deep popular passion for the Seleção. He defended Neymar's inclusion as positive despite the player's retirement after the tournament, and identified a lack of midfielders as the main shortfall for the 2030 cycle.

item.title: Lula critica Judiciário e defende reformas
item.description: President Lula criticized the Judiciary, stating that the CNJ and CNMP failed to fulfill the transformative role he expected when creating them, and argued for institutional reforms during the signing ceremony of women's protection bills in Brasília.

item.title: TSE afrouxa regras para big techs em nova versão de portaria e concentra decisões em Nunes Marques
item.description: The TSE has relaxed rules for digital platforms in the updated version of Ordinance 463, extending deadlines for compliance plans and reducing public transparency requirements. The decision also concentrates decision-making power in the presidency of the Court, currently held by Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, who now has exclusive authority to handle omissions, refusals to provide information, and electoral risks. Platforms with over 5 million active users in Brazil must still submit measures against disinformation, AI misuse, and coordinated inauthentic behavior, but with less collective oversight and more centralization in the hands of the TSE president.
